source.title: Some open problems on applications of complex analysis

trace.notes: Resolved zbMATH document 647390 through the zbMATH Open API metadata: Guo-Chun Wen, "Some open problems on applications of complex analysis", in Complex analysis and its applications, Pitman Research Notes in Mathematics Series 305, page 359, 1994. The zbMATH web page itself returned a Cloudflare challenge to local curl, so it was treated as a blocked resolver rather than a readable technical source. The API record contains no DOI, arXiv ID, or full-text links.

Failure mode: metadata_only after bounded exact-work recovery. Search attempts used the exact title, exact title plus PDF, exact title plus Wen, ISBNs 0-582-23181-7 and 0-470-23405-9, and the series/book title "Pitman Research Notes in Mathematics Series 305". Inspected candidates were rejected because they were bookstore or library-holding metadata, a preview of a different Pitman volume that only listed volume 305, a different 2006 Complex Analysis and Applications proceedings volume, or unrelated works/snippets. No readable exact-work PDF or full HTML artifact containing the problem statements was recovered, so no questions were extracted from resolver metadata, snippets, abstracts, or related works.
Saved failure JSON to outputs/parse-paper/647390.json and outputs/latest.json.
